Sure! Here’s a customizable 7‑day Paris itinerary that balances iconic sights, local experiences, and a bit of downtime. Feel free to tweak the days, add extra activities, or adjust the budget to fit your style. --- ## 📅 7‑Day Paris Itinerary (Sample) | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | |-----|---------|-----------|---------| | **1** | Arrive in Paris – transfer to hotel | Check‑in & quick stroll around your neighborhood | Welcome dinner at a classic bistro (e.g., Le Coupe Chou) | | **2** | Louvre Museum (early entry) | Walk through Palais Royal & Jardin des Tuileries | Seine river cruise at sunset | | **3** | Notre‑Cathédrale & Île de la Cité | Sainte‑Chapelle & Latin Quarter lunch | Jazz club in Saint‑Germain (e.g., Le Caveau) | | **4** | Eiffel Tower (skip‑the‑line ticket) | Picnic at Champ‑de‑Mars & Musée d’Orsay | Light show at the Eiffel Tower | | **5** | Montmartre: Sacré‑Coeur & artists’ square | Explore the Moulin Rouge area | Dinner at a Montmartre brasserie | | **6** | Day trip to Versailles (palace & gardens) | Return to Paris – relax in Luxembourg Gardens | Casual dinner near your hotel | | **7** | Shopping on Rue du Faubourg Saint‑Haussmann | Last‑minute souvenirs | Departure | --- ## ✈️ Travel Logistics | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Flights** | Book a round‑trip flight to Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY). Look for airlines like Air France, KLM, or budget carriers such as Ryanair/Eurowings if you’re traveling from Europe. | | **Airport Transfer** | • **RER B** train from CDG to Gare du Nord (≈30 min).
• **Orlyval** + RER B from Orly.
• Airport shuttle or rideshare (Uber, Bolt). | | **Accommodation** | • **Mid‑range**: Hotel Le Six (4‑star, €180/night).
• **Luxury**: Hôtel Plaza Athénée (5‑star, €650/night).
• **Budget**: Generator Paris (hostel, €35/night).
Book via Booking.com, Airbnb, or directly on the hotel’s site. | | **Transportation in Paris** | • **Paris Visite pass** (public transport + museum discounts).
• Metro & RER: 1‑day (€14.90) or 10‑ticket carnet (€17.90).
• Bicycle rental (Velib’) for short trips. | --- ## 🍽️ Dining Highlights | Category | Recommendation | |----------|----------------| | **Breakfast** | Café de Flore (classic croissants). | | **Lunch** | L’As du Fallafel (Latin Quarter). | | **Dinner** | Le Jules Verne (Eiffel Tower, Michelin‑starred). | | **Dessert** | Ladurée (macarons). | | **Coffee** | Café Angelina (hot chocolate). | --- ## 🎟️ Tickets & Reservations | Attraction | Ticket Type | Price (adult) | Notes | |------------|-------------|---------------|-------| | Louvre | Standard | €17 | Book online to skip the line. | | Eiffel Tower | Skip‑the‑line | €25 | Reserve for a specific time slot. | | Musée d’Orsay | Standard | €14 | Free on first Sunday of the month. | | Versailles | Palace & Gardens | €20 | Book a guided tour for deeper insight. | | Seine Cruise | Classic | €15 | Sunset cruises start at 18:00. | | Montmartre Walking Tour | Guided | €25 | Includes a visit to the Sacré‑Coeur. | --- ## 💰 Budget Breakdown (per person) | Category | Cost (EUR) | |----------|------------| | Flights | €200–€600 (depending on origin & season) | | Accommodation | €1200–€3500 (mid‑range to luxury) | | Food & Drink | €400–€800 | | Attractions & Tours | €200–€400 | | Transportation (within Paris) | €50–€100 | | Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | €100–€200 | | **Total** | **€2250–€5900** | *(Prices are approximate and vary by season, booking time, and currency fluctuations.)* --- ## 📌 Tips & Tricks 1. **Book tickets in advance** for major attractions to avoid long queues. 2. **Use the Paris Pass** if you plan to visit many museums; it bundles entry fees and public transport. 3. **Walk whenever possible** – many neighborhoods (Marais, Canal Saint‑Martin) are best explored on foot. 4. **Try local markets** (Marché Bastille, Marché d’Aligre) for fresh produce and affordable meals. 5. **Stay central** (1st–4th arrondissements) to minimize commute times. 6. **Learn basic French phrases** – locals appreciate the effort. 7. **Carry a reusable water bottle** – tap water is safe and free. --- ### Need help customizing this plan? Let me know your travel dates, budget range, interests (art, food, history, nightlife), and any special requirements (e.g., accessibility, dietary restrictions). I’ll tailor the itinerary to match your preferences!
